login.heroTitle: A calm operating home for Janzu practitioners worldwide.
login.heroBody: Manage session participants, sessions, certification progress, locations, events, and community workflows from one secure portal.

feedback.description:
Thank you for taking a minute to share your feedback about your Janzu session. Please write the name of the facilitator who gave you the session exactly as it was provided to you and be as truthful as possible in your responses. 
 Thank you very much!

firstSteps.title: First Steps
firstSteps.description: Follow the next valid action for your Trainee journey. Progress is saved across devices and this guide always remains available.
firstSteps.learningAllianceDescription: Acknowledge the current operational agreement. This is revocable and is not a legal signature or certification gate.
firstSteps.agreementStatement: I intend to participate respectfully, protect private session and feedback information, communicate boundaries and availability clearly, keep portal records honest, and seek support when a safety or relationship concern arises.
firstSteps.agreementNonLegal: This acknowledgement is non-legal, may be revoked at any time, and does not automatically change certification status.
firstSteps.profileDescription: Add your profile details and deliberately choose the audience for each eligible field.
firstSteps.trainingDescription: Submit official Level 1 or Level 2 training for verification.
firstSteps.instructorDescription: Send a request and wait for the Instructor to accept it.
firstSteps.calendarDescription: Understand time zones, recurring availability, booking states, and cancellation history.
firstSteps.sessionsDescription: Learn the private Session Participant and session-record workflow.
firstSteps.feedbackDescription: Learn how exact links, validation, notifications, and privacy work.
firstSteps.allianceRevoked: Learning Alliance acknowledgement revoked. The checklist item is incomplete.
firstSteps.invalid: The First Steps update was invalid.
